;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018 Liège attack]]
**Three people, including two [[Law enforcement in Belgium|police]] officers, are killed in [[Liège]], [[Belgium]], and four police officers are injured in a shooting. The gunman took a woman hostage, but was later killed by police. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-44289404 (BBC)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/may/29/belgium-gunman-kills-two-police-officers-and-passerby-liege (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Gaza–Israel conflict]]
**Palestinian militants in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] fire dozens of mortars at [[Israel]] in the heaviest such barrage in years. The [[Israeli Air Force]] responds with airstrikes on militant positions. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-44287594 (BBC)]
*[[Ukrainian crisis]]
**It is reported that [[Russia]]n journalist [[Arkady Babchenko]] is shot dead near his home in [[Kiev]], [[Ukraine]]. The day after, the event is revealed by the [[Ukrainian Security Service]] to have been staged as part of an operation to catch those who were trying to kill him. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ukraine-russia-journalist/prominent-russian-journalist-shot-dead-in-kiev-police-idUSKCN1IU2K7 (Reuters)] [https://www.nbcnewyork.com/news/national-international/Russian-Journalist-Shot-Killed-Ukrainian-Capital-483983981.html (NBC New York)]

;Arts and culture
*[[United States|U.S.]] television network [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]] cancels its recently revived sitcom ''[[Roseanne]]'' following a controversial [[Twitter|tweet]] from [[Roseanne Barr]] about former U.S. President [[Barack Obama]] aide [[Valerie Jarrett]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-44294632 (BBC)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2018/05/29/abc-cancels-roseanne-barrs-sitcom-after-her-tweet-about-black-obama-aide-valerie-jarrett.html (CNBC)]

;Business and economy
*[[2018 in video gaming]]
**The studio behind [[battle royale game]] ''[[PlayerUnknown's Battlegrounds]]'' (PUBG) sues [[Epic Games]] for allegedly copying their game with ''[[Fortnite Battle Royale]]''. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-44287860 (BBC)] [https://www.theverge.com/2018/5/29/17404516/pubg-epic-games-fortnite-lawsuit (''The Verge'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Subtropical Storm Alberto]], the first named [[Atlantic Ocean|Atlantic]] storm of 2018, makes landfall on the west coast of [[Florida]], [[United States]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/05/28/us/weather-storm-alberto-wxc/index.html (CNN)]
**Two [[WYFF]] journalists, Mike McCormick and Aaron Smeltzer, are killed after a tree crushes their car as they covered the storm in [[North Carolina]], [[United States]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-44287035 (BBC)]
*At least 50 people are reported to have died amid heavy thunder and lightning storms in northern [[India]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-44298824 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[International recognition of Abkhazia and South Ossetia]]
**[[Syria]] recognizes the disputed territories of [[Abkhazia]] and [[South Ossetia]] as independent states which in turn prompts [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]] to sever its relations with Syria. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-georgia-syria/georgia-to-sever-diplomatic-ties-with-syria-after-recognition-of-separatists-idUSKCN1IU22U (Reuters)]
*[[2018 China–United States trade dispute]]
**The [[Executive Office of the President of the United States|U.S. Government]] announces a 25% import tariff on [[US$]]50 billion of Chinese goods with "industrially significant technology". A full list of affected products will be published on June 15. Investment restrictions and enhanced export controls are to be announced on June 30. [https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2018/05/29/615117323/white-house-announces-tariffs-trade-restrictions-to-be-placed-on-china (NPR)]

;Law and crime
*[[Crime in the United Kingdom]]
**It is reported today that right-wing [[United Kingdom|British]] activist [[Tommy Robinson (activist)|Tommy Robinson]] was sentenced to 13 months in prison for [[contempt of court]] within five hours after being arrested outside [[Leeds Crown Court]] on 25 May. A ban on reporting his sentence is lifted today following a legal challenge by journalists. [https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/uk-news/english-defence-league-founder-tommy-12616030 (''The Mirror'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2018/may/29/edl-founder-tommy-robinson-jailed-13-months (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Censorship of Facebook]], [[Papua New Guinea#Health|Health in Papua New Guinea]]
**[[Papua New Guinea]] bans [[Facebook]] for a month "in order to research the social network’s effects on the population and to crack down on fake accounts." [http://thehill.com/policy/technology/389657-papua-new-guinea-to-ban-facebook-for-a-month (''The Hill'')]
*[[Kidnapping of Joshua Boyle and Caitlan Coleman]]
**Former [[Taliban]] hostage Joshua Boyle, awaiting trial on assault charges, is expected to hear Friday whether he'll be released on bail. [https://www.thestar.com/news/canada/2018/05/29/bail-decision-for-former-afghanistan-hostage-joshua-boyle-expected-friday.html (''The Star'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Libyan general election, 2018]]
**Four [[Libya]]n leaders – [[Fayez al-Sarraj]], [[Khalifa Haftar]], [[Aguila Saleh Issa|Aguila Saleh]] and head of the [[High Council of State (Libya)|Council of State]] Khaled al-Mishri – endorse a statement calling to hold "credible, peaceful" elections on 10 December. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/may/29/macron-hosts-libyan-factions-in-paris-in-push-to-secure-elections (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2017–18 United States political sexual scandals]]
**[[List of Governors of Missouri|Governor of Missouri]] [[Eric Greitens]] announces that he is resigning amid sexual misconduct and misuse of a charity donor list allegations against him. Greitens claims that he is the victim of a "political witch hunt". Lt. Governor [[Mike Parson]] will assume the governorship once Greitens' resignation takes effect on June 1. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-44297378 (BBC)] [http://www.stltoday.com/news/local/govt-and-politics/who-is-mike-parson-the-next-governor-of-missouri/collection_aeeaa244-8fee-5bdf-b9d2-98a037af2389.html (''St Louis Post-Dispatch'')]

;Sports
*[[Expansion of Major League Soccer]]
**[[FC Cincinnati]] is announced as the 26th expansion team of [[Major League Soccer]], set to begin play next year. [https://www.cincinnati.com/story/sports/soccer/fc-cincinnati/2018/05/29/its-official-fc-cincinnati-has-joined-mls-begin-play-2019/652201002/ (''The Cincinnati Enquirer'')]
